docs.description: Cam & Co Weekday Talk Show Covering Second Amendment-Related Issues Hosted by Cam Edwards, Cam & Co features news and views of the Second Amendment and other freedom-related issues. Tune in for interviews with NRA leaders, newsmakers, politicos, journalists and congressional leaders. It's in-depth commentary and analysis you won't find anywhere else. Cam & Co airs at 4:30 p.m. CT/5:30 p.m. ET on NRATV.com. The show is also available on demand on iHeartRadio and iTunes. Matt Walsh: Worst Anti-Gun Argument Ever Made Cam & Co airs weekdays 2-5 p.m. ET on NRATV. The writer says the Parkland activists miss the important lesson learned from the Waffle House shooting.
docs.title: Cam & Co - Matt Walsh: Worst Anti-Gun Argument Ever Made
